source.notes: Each case reseeds ThreadSafeRandom with `seed`, then makes the call four times on a TreasureDeath {Tier, LootQualityMod = qm, UnknownChances = heritage}. results: each return (enums as integers; `ref` rolls as [wcid, type]; lists element-wise), or {throws} and stop. post = Next(0, 999999). `X.Roll:n` passes the enum value n.
